categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in OEM manufacturing of golf club heads and related golf equipment. It has expanded into aerospace parts, automotive components, and precision metal parts production and sales. Additionally, it engages in high-end winter sports equipment manufacturing and sales through subsidiaries. The business also includes diversified product lines such as hand tools and composite materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include precision casting and forging for golf club heads, high-strength alloy development, high-temperature thermoplastic carbon fiber molding, titanium-aluminum intermetallic casting, Metal Injection Molding (MIM), and 3D metal printing. The company emphasizes smart manufacturing with intelligent scheduling, on-site management, automated equipment, and digital monitoring systems. It also develops advanced coatings like DLC and UV paints and employs vacuum diffusion welding and automated welding stations integrated with 3D optical inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global golf equipment brands primarily from the United States and Japan, including Callaway, TaylorMade, Titleist, Bridgestone, and Mizuno. It also supplies international automotive manufacturers and aerospace clients. The main markets are mature regions such as the US and Japan, with growing demand from emerging markets like China and Southeast Asia. Customers include OEM/ODM clients in golf, winter sports, automotive, and aerospace industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and manufacturing are based in Taiwan, China, and Vietnam, with a global sales footprint. The majority of sales are exports, with about 69% to the US, 14% to Japan, and the remainder to other regions. The company leverages Vietnam's cost and geopolitical advantages for production. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Hong Kong, Thailand, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a contract manufacturer and assembler of golf club heads and precision metal parts. It is vertically integrated in certain components through acquisitions. It also acts as a supplier to downstream brand owners and OEM customers in golf, automotive, and aerospace sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding global manufacturing layout, enhancing intelligent manufacturing and scientific production systems, and accelerating diversification into non-golf sectors such as aerospace, automotive, and hand tools. R&D focuses on new materials (high-strength stainless steel, titanium alloys, composites), innovative structural designs, automation, and digital transformation. The company integrates ESG principles and sustainability into its innovation and operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of OEM/ODM golf club heads and related equipment, as well as aerospace and automotive precision parts. The company also earns from sales of winter sports equipment and hand tools via subsidiaries. The business model is predominantly manufacturing and assembly with direct sales to brand owners and industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the world's largest OEM golf equipment manufacturer, leading in market share and production volume. Key competitors include other Taiwanese golf OEMs such as Ming An, Da Tian, and Ju Ming. Its competitive advantages stem from strong R&D, stable customer relationships, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and diversified product portfolio. It holds a leading position in titanium golf club head casting technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of NT$28.37 billion, a 16.4% increase from the previous year, and net income attributable to owners of NT$3.8 billion, up 57.9%. EPS rose to NT$28.17 from NT$18.18. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and asset base, supported by acquisitions and expanded production capacity. It maintains a strong financial structure with healthy cash flow and capital adequacy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, precision manufacturing with advanced materials and innovative designs tailored to customer needs. It offers integrated solutions with vertical integration in key components, rapid product development cycles, and stable delivery performance. Its commitment to ESG, sustainability, and smart manufacturing enhances customer value. The company differentiates through technological leadership in titanium casting, composite materials, and automated production processes.
